title: YELVERTON BARRY
html_source: Inversion of the name of the 18th c. Irish lawyer and orator Barry Yelverton.

anchor.prefix:
Carelessly.) I was just chatting this afternoon at the viceregal lodge to my old pals, sir Robert and lady Ball, astronomer royal at the levee. Sir Bob, I said... 

1922#440

 MRS
anchor.suffix: (In lowcorsaged opal balldress and elbowlength ivory gloves, wearing a sabletrimmed brickquilted dolman, a comb of brilliants and panache of osprey in her hair.) Arrest him, con
